rule: Every command is in GIS Workbench (Full). A command is also in GIS Workbench Lite only when it is listed here, in a group with a reason. A command that is not listed is Full only. tests/unit/profile.test.js and tests/e2e/25-mobile.spec.js check this list.
recordsRule: The store record types Lite shows. A project opened in Lite keeps every other record untouched and saves it back; Lite names them when it opens the project (features/files.js).

groups.title: Open from the device
groups.reason: A field user opens imagery, vectors and offline maps that are already on the phone; language and data packs are files too. All of it is read on the device, offline.

groups.title: View
groups.reason: Fit, zoom and orientation buttons back up the gestures (pan, pinch, rotate, double tap) and work for one-handed and switch users.

groups.title: Basic enhance
groups.reason: DRA, brightness, contrast and band presets are single taps on the GPU image chain: light, and what a phone screen in daylight needs. Filters, curves, histograms and fusion stay in Full.

groups.title: Coordinates and location
groups.reason: Reading, converting and jumping to coordinates and showing where the user stands are the core of field use. The device location needs the user's explicit permission each session.

groups.title: Measure
groups.reason: Point position, distance with bearing, length and area are taps on the image with the same sensor-model maths as Full.

groups.title: AOI and GRG
groups.reason: An area of interest and a gridded reference graphic are what a field team shares to talk about places; both are a few taps.

groups.title: Observations and annotations
groups.reason: Recording what the user sees, with a camera photo and a position, and marking it on the image is the main field task. Editing tools, schemas and extraction stay in Full.

groups.title: Export and share
groups.reason: Observations, the AOI, GRG and annotations leave the phone as KML or GeoJSON, through the system share sheet where the browser has one and as a download otherwise. A snapshot keeps the work, and its smaller images, in one file.

groups.title: Project file
groups.reason: A field survey saved as a project (.gwb) is finished in Full and opened again on the phone (OD-2.40, REQ-GAP-86). Lite saves the same file Full does, through the share sheet where the browser has one; it keeps every record it cannot show, so nothing made in Full is lost, and names those records when it opens the project. Imagery is referenced, never embedded, and is relinked on the device.

groups.title: Offline, languages and Preferences
groups.reason: The file works air-gapped; the user still chooses Online or Offline, the language and the units, and reads About.
